recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes for classifying current EvidenceVariable definitions should be raised against the current EvidenceVariable.definition, EvidenceVariable.definitionModifier, or referenced Group model rather than reopening the removed R5 characteristic.type element.
issue_request: FHIR-32646 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification R5 request to add EvidenceVariable.characteristic.type as a 0..1 CodeableConcept with an example binding to usage-context-type so a specific characteristic such as dexamethasone could also be classified as a type of intervention.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to commit bac01125124ef5d906e86c9f6d75340772380ce2, which added EvidenceVariable.characteristic.type with CodeableConcept type and a usage-context-type example binding. Later R5 issue FHIR-36635, implemented by 8019b7c9a69cae8d916756f78130981b23493354, refactored the same type/value capability into EvidenceVariable.characteristic.definitionByTypeAndValue.type[x].
additional_context: EvidenceVariable is active in source/fhir.ini. The current source no longer contains EvidenceVariable.characteristic because FHIR-42886 was an Applied R6 decision to replace EvidenceVariable.characteristic with EvidenceVariable.definition and use Group as the preferred resource for characteristic definitions. Commit b6ffbe50c67dfcc7f9ceac3463e582537ad2d85c applied that replacement by removing the characteristic backbone, including definitionByTypeAndValue.type.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Reintroducing EvidenceVariable.characteristic.type would conflict with the later Applied R6 model, so the current source is correct when FHIR-32646 is read together with subsequent EvidenceVariable refactors.

related_jiras.note: Refactored the FHIR-32646 type/value pattern into EvidenceVariable.characteristic.definitionByTypeAndValue during R5.

Added EvidenceVariable.definitionModifier after the characteristic removal; relevant to the current model but not a separate FHIR-32646 decision.
